• Inteligência de mercado e expansão de distribuição.

• Identificação de oportunidades de crescimento e novos PDVs.  
• Gestão de ruptura, demanda e disponibilidade de produtos.  
• Gestão de mix, fidelização e comportamento de compra.  
• Gestão de metas, performance comercial e produtividade de equipes.

• Visão integrada da cadeia: indústria + distribuidores + PDVs.

Name: Xcalibur Smart Mapping
Description:
Xcalibur Smart Mapping is the global leader in multi-source geodata integration, operating the world’s largest airborne geophysics fleet and proprietary sensing systems. Our expertise spans the full data value chain, from advanced acquisition and rigorous data management to sophisticated processing, fusion and interpretation, bringing together surface and subsurface information from airborne platforms, remote sensing, satellite imagery, LiDAR and third-party sources. 

Through decades of experience, we have developed a unique ability to harmonise vast, heterogeneous datasets and transform them into a unified Earth Intelligence capability. This architecture enables a holistic understanding of the territory, where every layer contributes to clearer, faster and more reliable decision-making. 

Powered by Artificial Intelligence and deep geoscientific expertise, we translate complex geodata into actionable insight that supports the responsible management of natural capital and strategic resources. Our integrated approach reveals patterns, risks and opportunities that remain invisible in isolated datasets, enhancing predictive accuracy, operational reliability and long-term planning. 

Across our international laboratories and collaborative research networks, we accelerate technological development, the design of advanced data models and the continuous enhancement of our platforms and fleet, consolidating a unique capacity for innovation applied to responsible exploration. 

At the core of our DNA lies Resource Intelligence, a data-driven methodology that converts vast, multi-source geoscientific information into actionable insight through intelligent data fusion, real-time monitoring and rigorous quality control.  

This foundation enables precise, collaborative, and sustainable exploration, supporting a more informed path toward a just and resilient energy transition through an AI-driven data platform called XENAI.

Name: CISO Lens

* Peer networking, 
* Structured collaboration, 
* Information sharing, 
* Community coordination and analysis, and 
* Benchmarking.

A key driver for the creation of CISO Lens was the recognition that cyber risk is a business issue that can be most effectively addressed through collaboration across organisations and industries.  

The services, set out above and in addition to the normal services of an ISAC, enable evidence-based decision making around strategy and resource allocation. The goal is to support governance and informed decision making, resulting in a commensurate and timely response to cyber risks.

Part of the challenge in presenting a commensurate response to online risks in a hyper-connected world is the need for continual evolution. These companies are more likely to have workplace flexibility, more likely to employ women and less likely to have a gender pay gap, so they are helping to create gender equality for their employees and communities.
 
How did the concept work?
Femeconomy certified over 2000 companies who had at least 30% women on the Board of Directors, or were 50% female owned. Femeconomy encouraged female consumers, budget owners and business owners to purchase from these companies, using economic levers to help advance gender equality. 

Gender equality procurement
As Femeconomy’s community grew so did the idea. Femeconomy advocated for large organisations and Governments across Australia to adopt gender equality procurement principles, and include women owned businesses in their supply chains.

Gender equality procurement was legislated in the US in 1994, providing a global evidence base for the social and economic benefits of supporting women in business. After meeting and presenting to all State and Federal Government representatives between 2019 and 2023, New South Wales, Western Australia, Queensland, South Australia, Victoria and the Federal Government all committed to gender equality procurement strategies.

This represents significant systemic and structural change to support women owned businesses across Australia. This is Femeconomy’s legacy, achieved through the support of an incredible community of women across Australia and globally who are committed to advancing gender equality.

For more information on Femeconomy's legacy and portfolio visit femeconomy.com

The Pacific Manuscripts Bureau (PMB or Pambu) was established at the Australian National University in 1968 with the support of an international consortium of libraries with a focus on Pacific collections. We prioritise digitising materials at risk of loss or damage due to the Pacific climate with its high humidity and frequency of natural disasters. We also prioritise collections that are in private hands that would otherwise be inaccessible to researchers. 

Using portable equipment (first microfilm, now digital) we work with collection owners at their premises to make copies for preservation and access purposes. Digital copies are supplied to the collection custodian, and distributed to our member libraries, who facilitate access for researchers. Collection custodians are invited to set access conditions. 

We also advocate for archives and libraries in the Pacific and for the preservation of the documentary of the Pacific region.

Name: Safety Rehabilitation and Compensation Licensees Association
Description:
The Commonwealth Comcare scheme licensing arrangements under the Safety, Rehabilitation and Compensation (SRC) Act 1988 commenced from 30 June 1992.  For many years there was a small number of licensees who were either current or former Commonwealth Authorities.

Australia Post and Telstra are the only two original licensees present at the commencement of licensing who continue to be licensees today.

During the period 2005 to 2009, 17 new organisations, who were either former Commonwealth Authorities or in competition with a Commonwealth Authority, were granted licenses to operate under the Comcare scheme.  Moving to the Comcare scheme allowed these national companies to self-insure their workers’ compensation and rehabilitation obligations and manage their work health and safety requirements under legislative provisions applying across all states and territories.

As the number of licensees increased it became apparent that in order to more effectively develop capability and influence the direction of the jurisdiction, licensees would need a more co-ordinated approach. Informal meetings had been occurring to share information and discuss issues, and in 2009 action commenced to formalise a licensee representative structure.

Initially, consideration was given to a third party organisation managing this function however, licensees decided to establish an independent incorporated association run by licensees themselves.

A series of meetings were held to name and establish the association of licensees.

On 9 November 2009 the first formal meeting of the Safety, Rehabilitation and Compensation Licensees Association (SRCLA) was conducted and the following initial office bearers were appointed:  Dean Stone (NAB) President; Michael Halloran (Australia Post) Vice President, Denise Fishlock (Asciano) Secretary; and Tamar Kiely (CBA) Treasurer.

Since 2009 the SRCLA has been active in representing licensees in the Comcare scheme and influencing the legislative and regulator

Our Purpose

Australia is one of the world’s most multicultural nations, and that diversity is one of its greatest strengths. We exist to make that transition smoother and more successful for every migrant who chooses to call Australia home. Our programs focus on settlement, education, employment, and community participation—key areas that determine whether newcomers can not only survive but truly thrive.

By helping people understand how Australian society works—from its social norms to its institutions—we empower them to participate fully and confidently. We also help the wider community appreciate the value of cultural diversity, fostering mutual respect and inclusion.
What We Do
Our work spans multiple levels—individual, community, and systemic. We deliver training, resources, and partnerships that address both immediate needs and long-term integration.
At the individual level, we equip migrants with essential knowledge and skills to navigate Australian life. Our workshops and coaching sessions cover practical topics such as housing, financial literacy, healthcare, education, and employment readiness.

Registered mercantile agents can only conduct a field call.

Urgency is limited to the number of available agents in the area and is usually done at the agent’s solidarity, hence no set time, specific time request can attract additional charges.

It can take up to a week to get an initial update

DRONE FIELD CALL is here to interrupt tradition field call service industry.

With an on-demand task fulfillment business concept, we no longer rely on traditional field call agents, instead, engaging an extensive network of on-demand service providers to provide footage of a location, asset or person on demand.

Description:
An airdrop is the free giveaway of new or existing crypto to its community. Sometimes it’s required that you already own the crypto to be rewarded with more. Other times it's purely just a marketing campaign. New crypto tend to offer airdrops to advertise their offering. Existing crypto conduct airdrops to reward holders of them.

At My Airdrops Club, we provide a service to find airdrops. We focus on those that offer a reward with a minimum value of AU$10. We have no direct affiliation with the crypto airdrops and we are not responsible for the outcomes. The airdrop terms and conditions may change, or the airdrop can be cancelled at any time. Each airdrop has strict criteria and terms and conditions. The general criteria may include:
•	Creating a new account
•	Filling in an airdrop form
•	Various social media activities e.g. liking, sharing, and following the airdrop pages.
•	Posting content on social media
•	Signing up for newsletters, and
•	Referring others to the airdrop

You will need a crypto wallet to receive most airdrops. A crypto wallet is where you store your crypto funds. When you create a crypto wallet, you will be given a public address which is your account number. This public address can only be used to receive deposits and can be shared with others from whom you are expecting a payment. You will also be given a private key which is a backup of your wallet and required if you lose access to your account. On some occasions you are also given a mnemonic passphrase, and this also acts like a private key. 

“Make sure you never give anyone or share your private keys. Anyone with access to this information will have access to your funds. “

We provide this service in good faith and we encourage you to do further research and only sign-up for airdrops you feel comfortable with.

If you have any questions or concerns, have a look at our FAQ on our website or please feel free to contact us.

Description:

Description:
Abby Health is Australia’s busiest online clinic, built for the future of primary care.

Founded in 2023, Abby was established to address one of the most urgent issues in Australian healthcare: access. With one in three Australians now without a regular GP, we're reimagining how people access everyday care—without losing what makes care personal: long-term relationships and detailed patient histories.

Our approach is guided by three core values:
 Smart – Intelligent systems that surface what matters, when it matters
 Beautiful – A thoughtful, intuitive experience for patients and clinicians alike
 Caring – Human support, continuity of care, and relationships that last

We believe the future of primary care is affordable, same-day, and online first.
A system where most care is delivered remotely—supported by pre-diagnosis tools, wearables, alerts, and proactive follow-up. In-person visits become the exception, not the default. It’s a smarter, safer, more efficient model—one that finally puts patients first.

And it’s already happening.

Since launching, Abby has become one of the most trusted names in digital healthcare in Australia. We’re used by hundreds of thousands of Australians, with a 4.7/5 average rating on Google and Trustpilot. 

We’re quality-first and purpose-driven. Whether you’re a patient looking for better answers or a clinician looking for a better way to practise—Abby is here to make care better, for everyone.

Smart. Beautiful. Caring. That’s the future we’re building—for Australian primary care, and the people who rely on it.

Name: KafkaGuard
Description:
KafkaGuard is an open-source compliance and security scanner for Apache Kafka. It evaluates your clusters against 55 production controls — SASL, SSL/TLS, ACLs, replication, retention, broker config,
  audit logging — and produces audit-grade reports mapped to PCI-DSS 4.0, SOC 2 Type II, and ISO 27001 requirements.

  Most Kafka environments fail compliance checks not because the platform is insecure, but because evidence isn't continuous. Auditors don't want a screenshot from the week before fieldwork — they want
  proof your controls were operating across the whole reporting period. KafkaGuard makes that evidence cheap to collect and easy to retain.

  What KafkaGuard does:

  - Scans Kafka clusters in seconds — config, ACLs, listeners, certificates, replication
  - Maps every finding to PCI-DSS, SOC 2, and ISO 27001 controls
  - Generates JSON, HTML, PDF, and CSV reports per scan
  - Works on Apache Kafka, Confluent Platform, Amazon MSK, Aiven, Redpanda, Strimzi, and KRaft clusters
  - Ships three policy tiers — baseline-dev (21 controls), enterprise-default (45), finance-iso (55) — all forkable YAML
  - Runs air-gapped: on-prem dashboard, no cloud dependencies, no telemetry
  - Integrates with CI/CD to block dangerous config changes before merge

  Who it's for:

  Platform engineers who own Kafka and need to answer "are we compliant?" without weeks of manual review. Security and compliance teams collecting evidence for SOC 2 Type II, PCI-DSS, ISO 27001, or DORA.
  Regulated industries — banking, healthcare, fintech, defense — running Kafka in air-gapped environments.

  KafkaGuard doesn't replace your IaC, your Strimzi operators, or your security team. It collects the evidence those systems already produce, in the format auditors actually accept — across every cluster,
   every week, automatically.

  Open source. Self-hosted. Your controls, your standards.

  → kafkaguard.com
  → https://github.com/KafkaGuard/kafkaguard-releases

Name: British Pensions in Australia Inc.
Description:
What is British Pensions in Australia Inc. (BPiA) 
BPiA is a registered charity dedicated to caring for British State Pension recipients in Australia. 
We were incorporated under the Associations Incorporation Act 2009 (NSW) in 2003. 
We are staffed entirely by unpaid volunteers. 
BPiA has adopted a membership funding model. This provides us with more reliable income to fund our 
activities. We ask people we help to join BPiA and agree to pay a modest annual membership fee. There is 
no obligation to join. We also ask members to add a donation to their membership fee. 
Mission Statement 
Our mission is to empower and support recipients of British state pension in Australia by providing reliable 
information, guidance, and resources related to their pension rights and entitlements. 
We are committed to fostering a community where individuals can navigate the complexities of the British 
state pension scheme with confidence and clarity.  
Through advocacy, education, and personalised assistance, we strive to ensure that every member can secure 
their financial future and enjoy peace of mind in their retirement journey. 
Together, we are dedicated to upholding the interests of British pensioners and enhancing their quality of 
life in Australia. 
How we help people who receive or with the passage of time will receive British State Pension 
We help people navigate the convoluted rules of the British state pension scheme. We lobby on their behalf 
to end the UK government’s frozen pensions policy. 
Amongst other things, our assistance includes guidance on how to: 
• Get a state pension forecast. 
• Understand the merits of voluntary contributions. 
• Claim British state pension. 
BPiA has a library of Fact Sheets that provide information in plain English on all aspects of British state 
pension.

Description:
Quoorum was born from a deep conviction: culture and knowledge should never be confined by borders.

Founded by linguists, translators, and passionate book lovers, Quoorum is a high-tech literary translation service specialised in long-form fiction and non-fiction. We set out to overcome the structural limitations of automated translation systems, which process text sequentially and struggle to maintain coherence, stylistic continuity, and narrative depth at book scale.

To address this, Quoorum has developed a unique hybrid system: a reflexive, non-linear, multi-perspective editorial process powered by advanced computational methods (our RNLMP framework). Translation is treated not as a fixed output, but as an ongoing editorial dialogue. The system generates and confronts multiple translation hypotheses and allows earlier choices to be questioned and revised as new context emerges—mirroring the way experienced literary translators rethink their decisions as a manuscript unfolds. Qualified human translators review and validate each project to ensure stylistic consistency, terminological accuracy, and fidelity to authorial intent. Every project is treated as a complete literary object, guided by a living editorial framework.

Beyond cost efficiency, Quoorum addresses a critical industry challenge: time-to-market. Many remarkable works—both new releases and valuable back catalogue titles—are never translated because opportunities are missed. By combining speed, reliability and editorial validation, Quoorum enables publishers, authors and rights holders to unlock and monetise their back catalogues while acting on current cultural or commercial momentum.

Quoorum delivers publication-ready literary translations that combine quality, speed and economic viability.
Culture belongs to all. Quoorum makes it accessible.

Name: Sizztech
Description:
Forecaz is a SaaS Platform designed to help governments and utilities predict the future of cities, how they grow, and demands this growth places on the assets, infrastructure and resources they manage.

The Forecaz SaaS platform made up of a cutting-edge Model Builder and Model Explorer combining data science, Artificial Intelligence (AI), and human planning expertise to automate urban growth modelling and demographic forecasting.

Unlike static zoning maps, Forecaz predicts where and when development will happen by analysing dynamic factors like infrastructure proximity, land availability, and market forces.

At its core, Forecaz uses Bayesian Network (BN) probabilistic models to calculate each parcel's 'Development Propensity' – the likelihood it reaches its highest-and-best use. It blends top-down targets ( such as state population projections) with bottom-up lot-level data (zoning, constraints, permits) for realistic scenarios.

Forecaz allows planners to create multiple "what-if" scenario models with independent parameters. For example, a city can test how different rezoning policies, urban renewal strategies, or new infrastructure projects (like a light rail extension) would change the timing and density of future growth. 

These scenarios help decision-makers choose the most effective strategies for long-term city planning.

Turning data into foresight — foresight into better cities.

Name: CovidVictoria
Description:
Enter, COVID-19. The greatest modern threat to our existence. The tangible manifestation of civilisation's greatest fear. The flaming meteor to end our unchallenged tenure on Earth. Didn’t Bill Gates predict a world-ending pandemic in his 2015 TedX talk?

“Sit down Bill!” the crowed had jeered,
“You can’t even save my Windows computer from viruses!”

Now the year is 2020, a global pandemic is afoot, and Bill Gates gazes smugly through trillionaire-tinted prescription spectacles. He shrugs his shoulders, and says “Well, I told you so”. Screw you Bill Gates, we've all prepared by watching the 2011-blockbuster, Contagion, and we don't need your help – imunocompenent Matt Damon will be our bridge over these troubled waters.

And so, the virus began to spread. We monitored the news with morbid vigilance as COVID cases exploded overseas. We urged our friends and family to exercise caution as the first cases were notified in Australia. We complied with tentative unease as borders closed, and our overseas/interstate family members were left to fend for themselves. And worst of all, we watched on with horror as every hooligan and their extended family absconded with packets of toilet paper from our supermarkets.

Soon, everyone found themselves confined within their homes, and I found myself on break from university. Day after day, I reviewed the typical tabular presentation of COVID statistics put forward by media outlets and government websites. These statistics were grouped by local government areas (LGAs), most of which were unknown to me. It became clear that I didn't know nearly enough about Victoria’s administrative regions to be able to draw any meaningful conclusions from these tabulated COVID statistics, and so I began my search for a visual medium. No matter how hard I searched, I couldn’t find a suitable resource, and so I covidvictoria.com.
